title: Autumn street-food market
description: Food trucks, Uzbek and Korean street food, a DJ from 19:00. Free entry.

title: Piano evening: Chopin and Rachmaninoff
description: Chamber recital in the composer's house-museum, 40 seats, tickets at the door.

title: Open-air cinema: classic Uzbek comedies
description: Two films with English subtitles, blankets provided.

title: Jazz jam session
description: House trio from 21:00, open jam after 22:30.

title: Farmers' breakfast tour
description: Guided tasting walk through the bazaar: fresh non, kaymak, dried fruit. In English and Russian.

title: Puppet show: The Clever Hare
description: For children 3 to 8, 50 minutes, in Uzbek and Russian.

title: Kids' science show: stars and planets
description: Interactive show under the dome for ages 6 to 12.

title: Photo exhibition: Tashkent modernism
description: Archive photographs of the city's 1960s-80s architecture.

title: Guided walk: Soviet-era mosaics
description: Two-hour walk in English, meeting point at the monument.

title: Stand-up night (in Russian)
description: Six comedians, open mic in the second half.

title: Board-game afternoon
description: Library of 80 games, hosts explain the rules.

title: Organ concert: Bach and Pärt
description: The cathedral's organ, 75 minutes, donations welcome.
